ten_ms.paper_fact: SONIC v1 uses consecutive 10 ms sine pips with 2 ms ramps at both ends. Its neural features use 5 ms bins; 10 ms pips do not mean 10 ms total latency.
ten_ms.paper_source: ../Paper_Notes.md, methods ledger; pinned v1 Sections 6.1-6.3, p11.
ten_ms.implementation: Precompute the full sequence and stream it continuously through the selected audio device. Each pip occupies an exact sample range. Do not use an operating-system timer to launch individual 10 ms sounds.
ten_ms.ramp_shape: Paper does not specify it. A chosen raised-cosine or other envelope would be a declared Rice choice; no waveform program or animal exposure is selected here.
ten_ms.latency_distinction: A fixed playback delay can exceed 10 ms while preserving 10 ms durations and spacing. Variation, dropouts and acoustic smearing must be measured separately from that fixed delay.
ten_ms.verification_status: Sample arithmetic is verified in this record. No physical 10 ms acoustic performance has been measured.

MR3.facts: Nominal 52 Hz-40 kHz; balanced TRS input; internal 24-bit/96 kHz processing. FAQ acknowledges playback delay, recommends firmware updates and describes delays after 15 minutes of network standby.
MR3.limit: No numeric ultrasonic response tolerance, selected-tone output level or 10 ms pip fidelity is established. Use wired input, document firmware/mode/EQ, and test standby behavior.

UMC204HD.facts: Two-input/four-output USB audio interface with up to 24-bit/192 kHz conversion.
UMC204HD.limit: A sample-rate specification alone does not qualify analog output response at 32 kHz. Measure loopback and the complete acoustic path before retaining high-frequency tones; bandwidth values from unverified manual columns are not adopted.

OmniMic_40k.facts: 96 kSa/s, calibrated range to 40 kHz, unit-specific calibration, oscilloscope for sound waveforms with trigger/free-run and freeze. Bundled workflow recommends Windows 10/11 and warns of unreliable Macintosh/Linux use.
limits: Oscilloscope display is documented; continuous raw arbitrary-pip export was not established.
PhotoLink timing is for sine-sweep Frequency Response mode, not general pip synchronization.
A 40 kHz ceiling cannot measure the 64 kHz second harmonic of a 32 kHz tone.
Frequency-response calibration does not establish assembled absolute SPL uncertainty or a 1 dB cross-frequency guarantee.

bench_acceptance_plan: Confirm host OS, driver, actual sample rate, explicit channel routing, physical output limits and monitoring disabled before wiring electrical loopback.
Check output-to-line-input loopback through 32 kHz, with documented gain/pad and clipping limits. This checks electrical delivery, not sound arrival.
Load the microphone serial calibration, establish reference geometry and verify sensitivity using a suitable reference/adapter. Choose and document a sound-level convention for short pips.
Measure long isolated tones at all candidate frequencies first; retain only frequencies with usable signal and level. Record background and in-band artifacts.
Inspect actual 10 ms ramped pips and representative frequency transitions acoustically, including 27/32 kHz, at the reference position. Assess duration/spacing, envelope, ringing and clipping.

Before asserting full-run timing validation, demonstrate continuous acoustic waveform capture and saved evidence. Compare actual sequence with its manifest to count missing/duplicate events and measure interval stability over a representative run.
Predeclare onset/envelope rules and tolerances. A proposed 1 ms duration/spacing tolerance is a commissioning target only, not an achieved result or a paper requirement.
Check warm startup and relevant idle/standby/restart cases; document mode, EQ, gain, firmware and sample-rate configuration. Have another team member reproduce the setup.

comparison_with_NI.reference: Existing proposed USB-6361 + TDT + M50/MM-1 comparison remains a reference, not confirmed equipment.
comparison_with_NI.tradeoff: This budget sound-only candidate replaces the NI playback unit with USB audio and uses a separate USB measurement device. It lacks an established shared acquisition clock/marker path, but that is deferred from this build. Both architectures still require acoustic verification.

actions: Research, budget arithmetic and documentation only. No hardware operation, sound playback, purchase, external message, animal experiment or achieved timing claim.
